# Test fonts

Static instances fetched from Google Fonts, used so text measurement, embedding,
and preview tests give the same answer on every machine. They are test fixtures
and are not published in the npm package.

| File | Family | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| Inter-400.ttf, Inter-700.ttf | Inter (Rasmus Andersson) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| SourceSerif4-400.ttf, SourceSerif4-700.ttf | Source Serif 4 (Adobe) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| JetBrainsMono-400.ttf | JetBrains Mono (JetBrains) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| Carlito-400.ttf, Carlito-700.ttf | Carlito (tyPoland Łukasz Dziedzic), metric-compatible with Calibri | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

The OFL permits bundling and redistribution with software. Full text:
https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/
